summary: P1 bounded pilot of Austin's provisional necessary felicity conditions: partial diagnostics, overlapping misfires/abuses and a two-step bet. Passing the checklist is not sufficient for felicity; achievement is not inferred from it.

sources.citation: Austin (1962), How to Do Things with Words, pp.5–11 and Lectures II–IV pp.12–52.
sources.available: Local primary source read within the stated scope; source inventory and limitations recorded. Independent source review pending.

definitions_mapped.source: A1 pp.14–18: A1 accepted conventional procedure, A2 appropriate persons/circumstances, B1 correct execution, B2 complete execution, Gamma1 attitudes/intentions, Gamma2 subsequent conduct. Gamma applicability is supplied.

definitions_mapped.coq: observations; passes; fails; failedb; report; assessed; refines
definitions_mapped.source: A1,A5,A6: added partial observation/reporting machinery; does not discover conventions, authority or sincerity.
A1–A3 pp.14–17: restricted necessary-condition diagnostics, distinct from independently supplied institutional achievement.
A2,A3,A5: assigned observations for source examples, not empirical predictions.
A4 pp.9,36–37: added strict recognizer for one isolated offer/acceptance exchange; later events are not modeled.
A6,A7: social judgments, procedural laxness, complete felicity criteria and general speech-act/assertion semantics.

theorems.name: condition_enumeration
theorems.source_claim: Enumeration helper for the six supplied condition labels.

theorems.name: report_exact
theorems.source_claim: Soundness and completeness of the added diagnostic report against its failure predicate.

theorems.name: passing_excludes_failure
theorems.source_claim: Passing and failing the same condition are incompatible in the diagnostic representation.

theorems.name: no_report_complete_when_assessed
theorems.source_claim: An empty report entails listed success only when all required observations are known.

theorems.name: known_failures_survive_refinement
theorems.source_claim: Previously known failures persist under information-preserving refinement.

theorems.name: misfire_blocks_intended_act
theorems.source_claim: pp.16–17 intended act cannot occur if an explicitly necessary A/B condition fails; necessity is a premise.

theorems.name: failed_necessary_condition_blocks_felicity
theorems.source_claim: pp.14–15 failed necessary condition rules out felicity; felicity implies listed conditions is an explicit premise.

theorems.name: Cases.unknown_is_not_success
theorems.source_claim: Countercase to treating missing observations as success.

theorems.name: Cases.insincere_promise_can_be_achieved
theorems.source_claim: pp.11,16,39–41 insincere promise; achievement is supplied as part of the example.

theorems.name: Cases.simultaneous_failures
theorems.source_claim: p.23 coexistence of A2 and Gamma1 failures; not an exclusive classification.

theorems.name: Cases.inapplicable_attitudes_not_failures
theorems.source_claim: p.15 Gamma applicability is conditional; non-required attitudes do not create a failure.

theorems.name: Cases.listed_conditions_are_not_sufficient
theorems.source_claim: Logical countermodel to checklist sufficiency with an additional unmet requirement; not a refutation of Austin.

theorems.name: Cases.void_act_can_have_other_effects
theorems.source_claim: p.17 an unauthorized ship-naming attempt can still break a bottle.

theorems.name: Cases.breach_not_incomplete_execution
theorems.source_claim: pp.39–44 subsequent breach is distinct from incomplete procedure execution.

theorems.name: Cases.truth_does_not_force_sincere_belief
theorems.source_claim: pp.41–43,49–50 truth and belief are independent coordinates here; no general assertion semantics.

theorems.name: Betting.broken_absorbing
theorems.source_claim: Absorption lemma for the strict recognizer's failure state.

theorems.name: Betting.complete_trace_exact
theorems.source_claim: Exact language of the added recognizer: a completed isolated exchange is offer followed by acceptance.

theorems.name: Betting.offer_requires_uptake
theorems.source_claim: pp.9,36–37 offer without acceptance does not complete this bet.

theorems.name: Betting.accepted_offer_completes
theorems.source_claim: pp.9,36–37 accepted offer completes this restricted recognizer.

theorems.name: Betting.refusal_and_reversed_order_fail
theorems.source_claim: Refusal and reversed ordering are negative tests of the added recognizer.

evidence: P1 bounded pilot of Austin's provisional necessary felicity conditions: partial diagnostics, overlapping misfires/abuses and a two-step bet. Passing the checklist is not sufficient for felicity; achievement is not inferred from it.
simplifications: A1 pp.14–18: A1 accepted conventional procedure, A2 appropriate persons/circumstances, B1 correct execution, B2 complete execution, Gamma1 attitudes/intentions, Gamma2 subsequent conduct. Gamma applicability is supplied.
A1–A3 pp.14–17: restricted necessary-condition diagnostics, distinct from independently supplied institutional achievement.
omissions: A6: no algorithm for accepted conventions, entitlement, sincere intention, exclusions or procedural laxness.
A7 is a coordinate countercase only, not a formal semantics of assertion or Moore's paradox.
additions: A1,A5,A6: added partial observation/reporting machinery; does not discover conventions, authority or sincerity.
